content: {"rules": ["Model exhibits severe downward bias when recent history shows a strong downtrend (e.g., falling from ~85 to ~77) followed by volatility; forecasts should be adjusted upward by +10% to +20% of the last 3 days' range.", "When sentiment shifts from neutral (0.00) to positive (0.20 or 0.33) after a price drop, the model fails to capture the subsequent mean reversion spike; apply a correction factor of +15 EUR for the first 7 forecast days.", "Model shows excessive smoothing and lag during high-volatility regimes where true outcomes swing >10% within 5 days; reduce forecast volatility by increasing step size or applying a 'spike detection' override if intraday range exceeds 3x average daily move.", "In Example 4, the model incorrectly predicts continued decline after a local low; rule: if price closes above the 7-day moving average while sentiment is neutral-to-positive, invert the trend signal immediately.", "Forecast horizon error: Model underestimates the magnitude of the 'V-shaped' recovery seen in Jan 2023 data; apply a convexity correction where forecasted values are weighted more heavily toward the end of the 30-day window to reflect delayed peak realization."]}
